main_text.head: SECT. XVI. De Authoritate Scriptura.
main_text.p: SEd illud adhuc longe iniquissimum est, αυτοπιστία verbo Dei denegare, & ita suspendere ab Ecclesia Scripturas, vt necesse illis sit authoritatem suam omnem ab humanis suffragijs emendicare: Bonus ille Eckius in repurgato a se demum Enchiridio, Scriptura (inquit) non est authentica, sine authoritate Ecclesiae ; cui sententiae vt vere aureae, ac nobili, adijcitur in margine gratulantis, ouantisque calami plausus ; Achilles

page.notes: The marginal note at left reads "Enchir. Eccij 7. recognitum. ann. 1536. fol.8." It is placed beside the paragraph. The Greek word after "iniquissimum est," is partly illegible in the scan; the transcription "αυτοπιστία" is uncertain and should be treated as [?]. The faint show-through text in the upper right of the page was omitted. The main text continues beyond the page.
